# Netscape HTTP Cookie File
# https://curl.se/docs/http-cookies.html
# This file is generated during API testing (e.g. using curl or Postman).
# It has been sanitized for security reasons so no active session tokens are committed to Version Control.

# Example format for testing authenticated endpoints:
# localhost	FALSE	/	FALSE	1794139447	csrftoken	<insert_your_test_csrf_here>
# localhost	FALSE	/	FALSE	1794139447	sessionid	<insert_your_test_sessionid_here>
# localhost	FALSE	/	FALSE	1794139447	theme	dark
